description: This file contains extension methods for IAsyncBatchObservable<T> to facilitate subscribing with delegate handlers, providing various overloads with default error and completion handlers.

classes.name: AsyncBatchObservableExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for IAsyncBatchObservable<T> to simplify subscription with delegate handlers.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Extension method to subscribe to an IAsyncBatchObservable<T> with delegate handlers for OnNextAsync, OnErrorAsync, and OnCompletedAsync, returning a Task of StreamSubscriptionHandle<T>.
